name: 1Zpresso JX-Pro
details: Hand grinder with external adjustment: 10 numbers per rotation, 4 clicks per number (2.2 = 2 rotations and 2 numbers). Also the JX-Pro S.

grindRanges.scale: rotations from zero (burrs closed); 2.2 = 2 rotations and 2 numbers

notes.moka: 1Zpresso groups moka pot with AeroPress and drip coffee maker.
notes.aeropress: 1Zpresso groups AeroPress, moka pot and drip coffee maker.

rangeInfo.note: 1Zpresso “Jx-Pro Grind Setting Reference” chart (JX-Pro-Grind-Setting-Reference-20200909.jpg on that page), in rotations: Turkish 0.8–1.2, espresso 1.2–1.6, AeroPress/moka/drip coffee maker 2.4–3.0, siphon/pour over 3.2–4.4, French press 4.2–5.0.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser. Dial in from there.
